name: PG Backup & Restore
description: Back up and restore PostgreSQL databases with pg_dump / pg_restore / psql: custom, tar, directory and plain SQL dumps, saved connections, live log, optional full schema reset before restore.
releaseNotes: Initial release: PostgreSQL backup (pg_dump) and restore (pg_restore/psql) workbench.
